ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white region is localized to the central peduncle-fluke junction, extending upwards in an irregular pillar shape toward the median notch. The lateral lobes are composed of contiguous low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a deep bounding-box depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern across both trailing edges, with prominent jagged peaks and valleys, particularly on the inner margin of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary concave curve along the trailing edges, transitioning to a convex upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, multi-tonal (white/beige) pixels at the terminal tips of both lobes, consistent with localized surface crusting. Numerous small, isolated white pixel points are scattered across the black regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned diagonal linear pixel disruptions are visible on the left lobe, cutting through the uniform black pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive textured accumulation of barnacles on the outer tips of both lobes; visible rake-mark abrasions on the left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The central white pigmentation pattern exhibits a jagged, bifurcated edge where it meets the black pigmentation at the fluke base.
